economy.summary: Her campaign says families, working singles, and retired seniors cannot afford to pay more, and supports harnessing Pennsylvania's energy resources to reduce consumer costs and promote energy independence.
economy.short: Says residents cannot afford more; backs energy resources to cut costs.

taxes.summary: Her campaign says she brought fiscal discipline to the state budget by combating overspending, preventing tax hikes, and reinvesting in the Rainy Day Fund.
taxes.short: Cites combating overspending, preventing tax hikes, rebuilding Rainy Day Fund.

abortion.summary: Says she is personally pro-life and will always support exceptions for rape, incest, and the life of the mother, and notes that current Pennsylvania abortion law remains unchanged.
abortion.short: Personally pro-life; supports rape, incest, life-of-mother exceptions.

education.summary: A former teacher, she says every child deserves the opportunity for a quality education; her campaign cites votes for record education funding and support for school safety grants, curriculum transparency, and parental involvement in educational decisions.
education.short: Cites education funding votes; supports curriculum transparency, parental involvement.

healthcare.summary: Says she supports initiatives that increase the access and affordability of healthcare for all Pennsylvanians.
healthcare.short: Supports initiatives increasing healthcare access and affordability.

energy.summary: Supports policies that safely harness Pennsylvania's energy resources, including clean energy, and supports preserving the state's farms and open spaces.
energy.short: Supports harnessing state energy resources, including clean energy; preserving farmland.

guns.summary: In the legislature she voted against bills restricting ghost guns and banning high-capacity weapons, and she opposes allowing municipalities to enact their own firearm regulations.
guns.short: Voted against ghost-gun and high-capacity restrictions; opposes municipal firearm rules.

economy.summary: Her campaign says she will work to bring down the cost of living for hardworking families and seniors and to attract businesses that provide good-paying jobs while protecting Pennsylvania's natural beauty.
economy.short: Proposes lowering cost of living; attracting good-paying jobs.

taxes.summary: Said during her 2024 campaign for the same seat that fairly funding public schools could provide property tax relief for residents.
taxes.short: Says fair school funding could provide property tax relief.

abortion.summary: Her campaign says she is running to protect reproductive freedom and that family planning decisions such as IVF and contraception should be made with doctors, not politicians.
abortion.short: Supports reproductive freedom; decisions with doctors, not politicians.

education.summary: Her platform says she will work to raise academic standards, encourage fair funding, and bolster trade programs so students receive a quality public education.
education.short: Proposes raising academic standards, fair funding, stronger trade programs.

healthcare.summary: Her platform calls for ensuring everyone, including seniors, has access to healthcare and childcare, expanding mental health services and preventative care, lowering prescription drug costs, and helping families with medical debt.
healthcare.short: Proposes expanding healthcare access, mental health services; lowering drug costs.

energy.summary: Her platform commits to addressing climate change and preserving a cleaner world, and to protecting Pennsylvania's natural spaces and recreational areas.
energy.short: Commits to addressing climate change, protecting natural spaces.

guns.summary: During her 2024 campaign for the same seat she said she backs what she called smart gun control, including a ban on assault weapons, and preventing gun violence in schools.
guns.short: Backs gun control including assault weapons ban; school safety.
